Within SOMA this arising is classified as a pattern because the principal ontological unit is an organized spatial configuration distributed across many cells rather than a single bounded object or a single process episode. This arising establishes the tissue-scale spatial order required for embryonic patterning, domain segregation, boundary formation, and the emergence of reproducible anatomical organization.

arisings.Name: Organogenesis and Functional Differentiation
arisings.ShortDescription: Object-level arising of discrete organs as integrated multicellular anatomical units with specialized functional roles.
arisings.Description: Organogenesis and Functional Differentiation denote the admissible object-level arising of discrete organs when morphogenetically patterned tissues become spatially integrated into bounded anatomical units with specialized physiological roles. Within Level 5 this arising produces coherent multicellular objects composed of multiple tissue types arranged in stable architectures that support organ-specific function, regulation, and persistence. The arising is realized through coordinated tissue patterning, differential growth, boundary stabilization, inter-tissue signaling, and functional alignment, yielding anatomical units whose operation depends on organized integration rather than simple aggregation of component tissues. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the principal ontological unit is a bounded, identifiable organ-level entity with stable anatomical identity across developmental and operational contexts. This arising establishes the organ-level structural basis required for specialized physiological subsystems such as glands, sensory organs, contractile organs, and internal regulatory structures.

arisings.Name: Multicellular Structural Integration
arisings.ShortDescription: Pattern-level arising of organism-scale structural coherence through aligned integration of tissues and organs into a unified body architecture.
arisings.Description: Multicellular Structural Integration denote the admissible pattern-level arising of organism-scale structural coherence when morphogenetically patterned tissues, organ-level units, and intercellular coordination mechanisms become aligned into a mechanically and functionally unified body architecture. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as stable global geometry, axial organization, relative positioning of organs, continuity of mechanical load paths, and coherent spatial integration across the multicellular body. The arising is realized through tissue alignment, boundary coordination, adhesion-mediated continuity, long-range signaling, and mechanically coupled stabilization, yielding whole-body structural order that cannot be reconstructed from isolated tissues considered independently. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a pattern because the principal ontological unit is a distributed organism-level configuration of spatial and mechanical coherence rather than a single bounded organ object or a single local developmental process. This arising establishes the body-scale structural organization required for coordinated load distribution, internal transport alignment, positional stability of organs, and higher-order systemic regulation.

arisings.Name: Tissue Repair and Regeneration
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level arising of controlled tissue restoration through coordinated repair, proliferation, differentiation, and remodeling under tissue-scale spatial guidance.
arisings.Description: Tissue Repair and Regeneration denote the admissible process-level arising through which damaged or lost tissue structures are restored by coordinated multicellular reconstruction within an existing organismal context. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as temporally organized repair and regenerative rebuilding that mobilize proliferation, migration, differentiation, debris clearance, matrix remodeling, and spatial re-patterning under guidance from pre-existing tissue architecture. The arising is realized when tissue-scale morphogenetic templates, cellular stress-response capacity, genomic maintenance, and local inflammatory-regime control are jointly integrated into a reconstruction trajectory that restores functional structure while preserving broader multicellular coherence. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because the principal ontological unit is an organized restorative transformation unfolding over time rather than a static tissue object or a persistent spatial pattern alone. This arising establishes the regenerative and reparative dynamics required for wound closure, structural restoration, controlled rebuilding after injury, and partial recovery of tissue-specific organization and function.

arisings.Name: Organization of the Extracellular Matrix
arisings.ShortDescription: Object-level arising of a persistent extracellular scaffold that organizes tissue mechanics, boundary structure, and matrix-mediated signaling conditions.
arisings.Description: Organization of the Extracellular Matrix denote the admissible object-level arising of a persistent extracellular scaffold when secreted matrix components, cell-matrix interactions, and tissue-scale mechanical constraints become integrated into a stable organized extracellular architecture. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a structured matrix object composed of aligned fibrillar, adhesive, and hydrated extracellular components that provide mechanical support, define tissue boundaries, transmit forces, and modulate diffusion and signaling conditions across tissues. The arising is realized through coordinated matrix deposition, alignment, crosslinking, remodeling, and cell-mediated anchoring, yielding an extracellular structural unit that persists beyond momentary cellular actions and functions as an active organizational medium for multicellular architecture. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the principal ontological unit is a bounded and persistent extracellular structural formation with identifiable tissue-level presence and organizational function. This arising establishes the extracellular scaffold required for tissue integrity, force distribution, positional stabilization, matrix-mediated signaling modulation, and long-range structural coordination across multicellular systems.

arisings.Name: Physiological Regulation and Organ Homeostasis
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level arising of stable organ-scale functional regulation through distributed multicellular feedback, signaling coordination, and systemic constraint maintenance.
arisings.Description: Physiological Regulation and Organ Homeostasis denote the admissible property-level arising of stable organ-scale functional regulation when tissues and organs are integrated into distributed feedback architectures that maintain viable internal conditions across the multicellular organism. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as the sustained capacity to regulate organ variables such as pressure, temperature, chemical composition, flow conditions, and functional output within bounded operational ranges despite ongoing perturbation. The arising is realized through coordinated cross-tissue signaling, feedback control, structural coupling, local maintenance mechanisms, and systemic regulatory compensation, yielding a persistent regulatory property of organ systems rather than a single transient process episode or a single bounded anatomical object. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because the principal ontological unit is the stable regulatory capacity of organs and organ systems to preserve functional state under variable conditions. This arising establishes the multicellular homeostatic capacity required for physiological stability, organ function preservation, systemic balance, and adaptive compensation across distributed tissue networks.

arisings.Name: Development of the Vascular System
arisings.ShortDescription: Object-level arising of branched, lumenized vascular transport networks formed through guided angiogenic sprouting and flow-dependent remodeling.
arisings.Description: Development of the Vascular System denotes the admissible object-level arising of dedicated multicellular transport networks that distribute oxygen, nutrients, metabolites, and signaling substances across tissues and organs. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a structured vascular architecture composed of branching conduits, differentiated vessel segments, and exchange interfaces that connect tissue morphology to metabolic demand and support scalable multicellular viability. The arising is realized through angiogenic guidance, in which endothelial tip cells follow growth-factor gradients and extend sprouts that lumenize behind the tip, through branching control and lumen formation, and through flow-dependent remodeling, in which hemodynamic force reorganizes the primary plexus into a hierarchical tree. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the principal ontological unit is an identifiable vascular network with stable anatomical presence and transport function. This arising establishes the transport infrastructure required for tissue perfusion, metabolic support, spatial scaling of organs, removal of byproducts, and distribution of signaling substances throughout multicellular systems.

arisings.Name: Nervous System and Physiological Coordination of Organs
arisings.ShortDescription: Object-level arising of distributed neural coordination networks enabling rapid timing, reflexive control, and physiological synchronization across organs and tissues.
arisings.Description: Nervous System and Physiological Coordination of Organs denote the admissible object-level arising of distributed neural control architecture that coordinates organs and tissues through rapid signal propagation and organized excitable pathways. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a structured multicellular network object composed of specialized neuronal and glial elements arranged into reflex pathways, autonomic branches, conduction routes, and organ-coupling circuits that support fast physiological timing and control. The arising is realized through neural differentiation, membrane excitability, synaptic signaling, pathfinding, and circuit stabilization, yielding a persistent coordination system that links distant tissues into temporally organized regulatory action. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the principal ontological unit is an identifiable neural system architecture with stable anatomical presence and coordination function, rather than a single signaling event or a higher-level cognitive property. This arising establishes the rapid-control infrastructure required for reflex arcs, autonomic regulation, temporal synchronization of organ activity, and fast physiological coordination that complements slower hormonal and metabolic regulation.

arisings.Name: Endocrine Regulation and Hormonal Systems
arisings.ShortDescription: Object-level arising of systemic hormonal regulation architectures enabling slow, sustained coordination of physiological states across distant organs and tissues.
arisings.Description: Endocrine Regulation and Hormonal Systems denote the admissible object-level arising of distributed hormonal control architecture when specialized endocrine cells, secretory tissues, circulating carriers, and hormone-responsive targets become integrated into a body-wide regulatory system. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a structured multicellular signaling network object composed of endocrine glands, hormone-producing cells, circulating messengers, target receptors, and feedback-linked regulatory pathways that coordinate growth, metabolism, reproduction, stress response, and long-term physiological state. The arising is realized through hormone synthesis, secretion, circulation-dependent distribution, receptor-specific recognition, and feedback stabilization, yielding a persistent systemic regulatory formation that complements faster neural coordination with slower but sustained modulation of organismal regimes. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the principal ontological unit is an identifiable endocrine system architecture with stable anatomical and functional organization across physiological contexts. This arising establishes the long-range hormonal infrastructure required for concentration-dependent regulation, coordinated state modulation across distant organs, and persistent adjustment of organism-level physiological regimes.

arisings.Name: Organism-Scale Immune Defense Architecture
arisings.ShortDescription: Object-level integrated immune-defense architecture coordinating barrier protection, surveillance, threat response, clearance, and systemic protective regulation.
arisings.Description: Organism-Scale Immune Defense Architecture denotes the admissible object-level arising through which diverse immune, barrier, inflammatory, surveillance, and regulatory subsystems become integrated into a coherent organism-scale protective architecture capable of preserving integrity across heterogeneous tissues and environmental exposures. This arising does not consist merely in the coexistence of multiple immune mechanisms, but in their stable structural integration into a distributed defense object whose components coordinate recognition of threats, mobilization of effectors, control of inflammatory amplitude, elimination of pathogens or damaged cellular targets, maintenance of tissue-compatible protection, and restoration of functional continuity after perturbation. It includes the organized coupling of barrier interfaces, innate immune recognition, cytokine communication, myeloid and lymphoid specialization, surveillance of transformed or infected targets, systemic alerting, and regulatory circuits that prevent uncontrolled self-damage. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the immune system at this scale functions as a persistent organized whole with identifiable internal architecture, distributed yet bounded operational unity, and stable causal participation in organism-level survival, repair, and adaptive protection.

arisings.Name: Formation and Specialization of Basic Tissue Types
arisings.ShortDescription: Pattern-level formation of a finite repertoire of recurrent tissue-class architectures serving as canonical multicellular organizational forms.
arisings.Description: Formation and Specialization of Basic Tissue Types denote the admissible pattern-level arising through which multicellular development stabilizes a finite repertoire of recurrent tissue-class organizations serving as canonical structural forms for higher-level biological architecture. This arising is not a single tissue instance, but a class-defining organizational pattern through which cells, extracellular matrix, polarity systems, mechanical relations, signaling interfaces, and physiological roles become reproducibly arranged into recognizable tissue-level regimes such as epithelial, connective, muscular, and neural organizations. Each such tissue class is defined not only by composition, but by a characteristic structural logic involving cell geometry, attachment mode, matrix dependence, exchange relations, force handling, and information transfer. The arising therefore captures the transition from generic multicellular aggregation to persistent tissue-type differentiation, where recurring structural families become admissible as stable mesoscopic building patterns for organogenesis, repair, barrier formation, coordination, and large-scale functional specialization.

arisings.Name: Stem Cells and Regulation of Their Niches
arisings.ShortDescription: Object-level arising of niche-regulated stem cell maintenance architectures enabling controlled self-renewal, activation, and lineage allocation within tissues.
arisings.Description: Stem Cells and Regulation of Their Niches denote the admissible object-level arising of localized tissue architectures that maintain self-renewing cell populations under specialized structural and signaling regulation. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a persistent niche-system object composed of stem cells, enabling cells, extracellular matrix, contact-dependent constraints, and signaling gradients that jointly regulate quiescence, activation, proliferation, and lineage commitment. The arising is realized through tissue-level microenvironment formation, feedback-controlled signaling, spatial confinement, and lineage-channel stabilization, yielding a stable multicellular maintenance architecture in which stemness is preserved as a relationally sustained condition rather than a purely intrinsic cellular property. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the principal ontological unit is an identifiable niche-regulated structural system with persistent organization and functional role in tissue renewal. This arising establishes the tissue-level maintenance infrastructure required for controlled replacement of cells, regenerative reserve, lineage production, and long-term preservation of renewal capacity within multicellular tissues.

arisings.Name: Hormonal–Neural Integration (Neuroendocrine System)
arisings.ShortDescription: Pattern-level arising of unified neuroendocrine regulatory coupling that aligns rapid neural control with slower hormonal modulation across the organism.
arisings.Description: Hormonal–Neural Integration (Neuroendocrine System) denote the admissible pattern-level arising of unified systemic control when neural coordination architecture and endocrine regulation become structurally coupled into a shared regulatory configuration. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a recurrent multicellular control pattern that links rapid targeted neural signaling with slower body-wide hormonal modulation, enabling temporally layered coordination of growth, metabolism, reproduction, stress response, and organ-level homeostatic stability. The arising is realized through bidirectional coupling between neural pathways and endocrine signaling loops, cross-scale feedback alignment, and shared regulation of physiological variables, yielding a stable higher-order control pattern that organizes multiple regulatory modalities into a single integrated regime. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a pattern because the principal ontological unit is the distributed configuration of coupled control relations spanning neural and endocrine systems rather than a single anatomical object or a single transient process episode. This arising establishes multicellular regulatory closure across fast and slow physiological control modes and provides the integrated control architecture required for organism-scale coordination without invoking cognition or behavioral planning.

arisings.Name: Tissue Plasticity and Pathological Reconfigurations
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level arising of tissue capacity for structural reorganization into adaptive or pathological configurations under persistent perturbation and altered regulatory regimes.
arisings.Description: Tissue Plasticity and Pathological Reconfigurations denote the admissible property-level arising through which multicellular tissues retain the capacity to reorganize structure, composition, and functional coupling under sustained perturbation, chronic load, or altered regulatory conditions. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a persistent reconfiguration capacity that can generate adaptive remodeling, compensatory hypertrophy, fibrosis, dysplasia, and other non-canonical tissue states that preserve partial viability while altering function and systemic integration. The arising is realized when morphogenetic pattern potential, regenerative remodeling dynamics, cellular stress-response regulation, and contextual inflammatory constraints remain sufficiently accessible to permit stable tissue-level reorganization beyond baseline architectures. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because the principal ontological unit is the tissue-level capacity for regulated reconfiguration under changing conditions rather than a single static malformed object or a single transient remodeling episode. This arising establishes the multicellular susceptibility and flexibility through which tissues can enter alternative structural regimes, including both compensatory adaptation and pathological stabilization.

arisings.Name: Trophic Regulation of Cellular Metabolism
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level arising of downward metabolic regulation in which tissue and organ-level trophic conditions constrain cellular energetic allocation and pathway use.
arisings.Description: Trophic Regulation of Cellular Metabolism denote the admissible property-level arising through which multicellular tissues and organs impose sustained regulatory constraints on cellular metabolic activity by means of nutrient supply architecture, hormonal modulation, growth-factor signaling, inflammatory context, and local microenvironmental conditions. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a stable higher-level regulatory capacity to bias cellular pathway activation, energetic allocation, substrate prioritization, and metabolic state according to tissue and organismal demands rather than local biochemical optimization alone. The arising is realized when organ-level homeostatic control, trophic supply conditions, immune-context signaling, and pre-existing cellular metabolic response spaces become integrated into persistent downward regulatory envelopes acting on cells. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because the principal ontological unit is the stable regulatory capacity of higher multicellular organization to constrain and reorganize cellular metabolism rather than a single trophic event or a single anatomical structure. This arising establishes the downward metabolic control required for coordinated resource allocation, context-dependent cellular energetic behavior, and alignment of intracellular metabolism with tissue and organismal functional regimes.

arisings.Name: Organizing Influence of the Extracellular Matrix on Cell Phenotype
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level arising of downward phenotypic regulation in which tissue-level extracellular matrix organization constrains cellular identity, state, and behavior.
arisings.Description: Organizing Influence of the Extracellular Matrix on Cell Phenotype denote the admissible property-level arising through which tissue-level extracellular matrix organization imposes persistent constraints on cellular phenotype, differentiation state, polarity, cytoskeletal organization, and functional behavior. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a stable higher-level regulatory capacity of matrix composition, stiffness, topology, spatial organization, and matrix-mediated signaling to bias gene expression and cell-state maintenance across embedded cellular populations. The arising is realized when organized extracellular matrix architecture, cell-matrix attachment systems, mechanotransductive coupling, and pre-existing cellular response spaces become integrated into a sustained downward regulatory context acting on cells. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because the principal ontological unit is the stable regulatory influence exerted by organized tissue-level matrix conditions on cellular phenotype rather than a single matrix object alone or a single transient signaling event. This arising establishes the tissue-level contextual control through which extracellular structure continuously conditions cellular identity and phenotype beyond lineage-specific intrinsic programs.

arisings.Name: Neuroendocrine Influence on Gene Expression
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level arising of cross-scale regulatory control in which neuroendocrine signals reshape cellular gene-expression states across tissues.
arisings.Description: Neuroendocrine Influence on Gene Expression denote the admissible property-level arising through which integrated neural and hormonal control systems modulate transcriptional and epigenetic states of cells across multicellular tissues. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a stable cross-scale regulatory capacity by which organism-level physiological regimes bias cellular gene-expression profiles, chromatin-associated regulation, and transcriptional response programs in accordance with systemic demands such as growth, stress adaptation, reproduction, and metabolic coordination. The arising is realized when neural timing signals, endocrine modulation, receptor-mediated transduction, second-messenger pathways, and intracellular gene-regulatory machinery become integrated into a persistent regulatory envelope spanning multicellular control architecture and cellular expression systems. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because the principal ontological unit is the stable regulatory influence exerted by neuroendocrine organization on gene-expression state rather than a single hormonal event or a single molecular mechanism. This arising establishes the cross-scale control through which organismal physiological state can reorganize cellular transcriptional programs without altering genomic sequence.

arisings.Name: Neural Regulation of Proliferative State in Target Tissues
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level downward regulation in which neural signaling modulates quiescence, proliferative entry, and division timing in selected target tissues.
arisings.Description: Neural Regulation of Proliferative State in Target Tissues denotes the admissible property-level arising through which neural organization acquires the capacity to modulate proliferative readiness, quiescence, checkpoint passage, and renewal dynamics in specific responsive tissues and niche environments. This arising does not imply a universal top-down control of all cell division throughout the organism. Instead, it formalizes a structured higher-level regulatory property by which patterned neural activity, neurotransmitter signaling, neuropeptide release, neuroendocrine coupling, and state-dependent physiological control become capable of shifting proliferative thresholds and renewal behavior in selected target-cell populations. Such regulation can alter entry into the cell cycle, reinforce arrest, bias regeneration, modulate stem-cell niche activity, or reshape proliferative timing according to organism-level conditions such as stress, circadian state, damage, or sensory-driven context. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because it consists in the stable possession of a cross-level regulatory influence exerted by neural organization upon tissue growth dynamics rather than in a bounded tissue object or a single transient event.

arisings.Name: Eye Optical Interface
arisings.ShortDescription: Object-level arising of a multicellular optical boundary system that projects structured external light onto the retinal surface.
arisings.Description: Eye Optical Interface denote the admissible object-level arising of a multicellular optical system formed when specialized tissues are integrated into a coherent refraction and projection architecture linking the external light environment to the retinal surface. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a bounded anatomical optical object composed of cornea, lens, pupil, chamber media, and enabling alignment structures that collectively establish refraction, focusing, aperture control, transparency, and optical-axis stability. The arising is realized through organ-level anatomical integration, tissue morphogenetic precision, and stable coupling among transparent and enabling tissues, yielding an optical boundary unit that transforms continuous external light fields into a structured irradiance distribution on the retina without itself performing neural transduction or cognitive processing. Within SOMA this arising is classified as an object because the principal ontological unit is an identifiable multicellular optical interface with stable structural identity and boundary-mediating function. This arising establishes the optical projection infrastructure required for image formation on retinal tissue and for subsequent downstream sensory transduction.

arisings.Name: Retinal Sampling Geometry and Ordered Visual Mapping
arisings.ShortDescription: Pattern-level structured visual-field sampling through non-uniform retinal mosaic organization and stable ordered mapping of retinal loci to visual space.
arisings.Description: Retinal Sampling Geometry and Ordered Visual Mapping denote the admissible pattern-level arising through which the visual surface of the retina becomes organized into a non-uniform yet systematically ordered sampling architecture that constrains how optical information is acquired and spatially related to visual coordinates. This arising is not reducible to the mere presence of photoreceptors or to optical input alone. It consists in a stable organizational pattern defined by receptor-density gradients, spatial anisotropy, layered retinal circuitry, local convergence ratios, region-specific acuity, and persistent correspondence relations between retinal loci and ordered visual-space structure. Through this patterned arrangement, different portions of the visual field are sampled with differing spatial resolution, sensitivity, and processing bias, while preserving an ordered map that can support downstream spatial coding and visual coordination. The arising therefore formalizes the retinal transition from simple light-sensitive tissue to a geometrically structured visual acquisition surface whose internal organization shapes perceptual precision, field distribution, and later neural interpretation.

arisings.Name: Retinal Circuit Preprocessing
arisings.ShortDescription: Pattern-level arising of local retinal signal transformation through circuit-based filtering, contrast enhancement, and adaptive visual preprocessing before higher transmission.
arisings.Description: Retinal Circuit Preprocessing denote the admissible pattern-level arising through which multicellular neural circuits within the retina transform photoreceptor-derived signals into structured output patterns before transmission to higher visual centers. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a stable circuit-level processing pattern including lateral inhibition, center-surround antagonism, gain adjustment, temporal filtering, and spatial differentiation that selectively enhances informative variation while suppressing redundancy and noise. The arising is realized through the interaction of retinal sampling geometry, specialized layered neural tissue organization, and inhibitory and excitatory signaling mechanisms, yielding a distributed preprocessing pattern that reshapes incoming irradiance-derived signals into contrast-sensitive and temporally modulated outputs. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a pattern because the principal ontological unit is a recurrent distributed organization of signal-transformation relations across retinal circuitry rather than a single retinal object or an isolated signaling event. This arising establishes the tissue-level visual preprocessing structure required for primary feature extraction, contrast enhancement, and early filtering prior to cortical or higher sensory integration.

arisings.Name: Retinal Ganglion Spike Encoding
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level arising of graded-to-discrete retinal output transformation through ganglion-cell spike generation for long-range visual signal transmission.
arisings.Description: Retinal Ganglion Spike Encoding denote the admissible process-level arising through which graded membrane-potential patterns generated by retinal preprocessing circuits are converted into discrete action-potential sequences by ganglion cells. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a temporally organized transformation from analog synaptic input distributions to spike-based output streams suitable for axonal propagation, temporal multiplexing, and noise-resistant communication. The arising is realized through the interaction of retinal circuit preprocessing, membrane excitability and threshold dynamics, and synaptic coupling mechanisms that together generate discrete spike trains whose timing, rate, and synchrony carry visual information extracted at earlier retinal stages. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because the principal ontological unit is an active graded-to-discrete transformation unfolding in time rather than a static retinal structure or a persistent spatial pattern alone. This arising establishes the retinal output transition required to bridge local analog sensory preprocessing and downstream spike-based neural communication.

arisings.Name: Tissue Inflammatory Microenvironments
arisings.ShortDescription: Pattern-level localized inflammatory tissue contexts stabilized by immune signaling, matrix organization, transport constraints, and compartmental structure.
arisings.Description: Tissue Inflammatory Microenvironments denote the admissible pattern-level arising through which inflammation becomes spatially partitioned into localized tissue-scale contexts characterized by distinct signaling composition, transport limitations, immune-cell residency, extracellular matrix remodeling, and persistent local regulatory bias. This arising does not refer to a single inflammatory signal or a single bounded lesion object. Instead, it captures the patterned formation of heterogeneous mesoscale domains within tissues where cytokine exposure, metabolic constraints, matrix organization, vascular access, stromal composition, immune-cell interactions, and damage-associated cues combine into locally stabilized inflammatory conditions. These microenvironments can differ markedly from surrounding tissue in activation threshold, resolution capacity, repair tendency, immune recruitment, and responsiveness to systemic signals. The arising therefore formalizes how tissue-scale inflammatory organization becomes regionally structured rather than uniformly distributed, creating persistent local contexts that bias cellular state, immune coordination, remodeling trajectories, and the progression or maintenance of chronic pathology.

arisings.Name: Gut Barrier Dysfunction and Microbial-Component Translocation
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level barrier-failure regime in which intestinal destabilization permits translocation of microbial components and sustains chronic inflammatory drive.
arisings.Description: Gut Barrier Dysfunction and Microbial-Component Translocation denote the admissible process-level arising through which compromised intestinal boundary integrity permits translocation of microbial components into circulation and thereby sustains chronic low-grade inflammatory drive. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a regulated barrier-failure process rather than a single acute breach, involving progressive shifts in permeability caused by extracellular matrix remodeling, altered epithelial junction coordination, epithelial stress responses, impaired restoration dynamics, and dysregulated homeostatic control. The arising is realized when local barrier weakening becomes coupled to transport processes that convert intestinal structural instability into systemic exposure to lipopolysaccharide and related microbial signals, thereby linking environmental input and gut-local dysfunction to organism-level immune and metabolic perturbation. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because the principal ontological unit is a temporally unfolding boundary-failure and translocation trajectory rather than a static gut object or a mere inflammatory property. This arising establishes a critical coupling pathway through which chronic permeability shifts at the intestinal interface can stabilize metabolic endotoxemia and broader inflammatory states.

arisings.Name: Chronic Low-Grade Inflammation
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level arising of a persistent organism-scale inflammatory regime characterized by elevated basal immune signaling and shifted regulatory set-points.
arisings.Description: Chronic Low-Grade Inflammation denotes the admissible property-level arising in which a persistently elevated inflammatory background becomes stabilized as a long-duration organism-level operating condition without requiring acute infection, severe injury, or discrete episodic inflammatory activation. This arising is not a brief response event, but a durable contextual property of the organism expressed through sustained shifts in cytokine background, innate activation tone, immune-cell thresholding, tissue responsiveness, repair bias, vascular signaling, and systemic inflammatory set-points. It emerges when repeated weak inflammatory inputs, impaired resolution, tissue inflammatory microenvironments, gut-derived immune stimulation, metabolic dysregulation, senescence-associated signaling, and innate memory-like reprogramming become sufficiently integrated to hold the organism above its prior homeostatic inflammatory baseline. The resulting condition does not usually produce the dramatic signatures of acute inflammation, yet it continuously reshapes cellular permissibility, tissue maintenance, immune allocation, and vulnerability to degenerative, metabolic, and age-associated dysfunction. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because it consists in the stable possession of an altered organism-wide inflammatory operating context rather than in a single bounded lesion, tissue object, or transient process.

arisings.Name: Immune Resilience vs Immune Constraint Trade-off
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level stabilized organism-scale balance between effective immune responsiveness and chronic regulatory constraint under persistent inflammatory load.
arisings.Description: Immune Resilience vs Immune Constraint Trade-off denotes the admissible property-level arising through which organism-scale immune regulation settles into a constrained balance between preserving sufficient protective responsiveness and limiting the cumulative damage, energetic cost, and self-destructive potential of persistent immune activation. This arising is not a binary switch between strong immunity and weak immunity. Rather, it expresses a stable higher-level trade-off structure in which activation thresholds, effector deployment, tolerance mechanisms, repair compatibility, inflammatory restraint, and resource allocation are co-tuned under chronic load. As inflammatory background rises and repeated immune demand accumulates, the organism cannot maximize all immune objectives simultaneously: maintenance of surveillance, pathogen defense, tissue compatibility, resolution, and self-protection come into tension. The arising therefore captures the stabilized balance point at which immune robustness is preserved only together with compensatory restriction, dampening, redistribution, or narrowing of available immune operating modes. Within SOMA this is a property because it characterizes the organism by a persistent immune-regulatory trade-off regime rather than by a discrete immune object or singular response episode.

arisings.Name: Inflammation Resolution Capacity
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level arising of active pro-resolving control that defines the system’s ability to terminate inflammation and restore homeostatic immune-tissue relations.
arisings.Description: Inflammation Resolution Capacity denote the admissible property-level arising through which multicellular systems actively terminate inflammatory responses and restore viable immune-tissue relations after perturbation. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as a stable regulatory capacity rather than passive inflammatory decay, encompassing the ability to engage pro-resolving mediators, coordinate immune downshifts, support debris clearance, enable tissue repair, re-establish barrier integrity, and normalize inflammatory tone without abolishing core defense competence. The capacity ranges from efficient return to a low-activation baseline down to a failure regime in which inflammatory-cell decline is delayed, apoptotic-cell clearance is impaired, recovery remains incomplete and inflammatory activity recurs. The arising is realized when organism-level homeostatic targets, immune-system regulatory architecture, cellular stress conditions, signaling-network coordination, and contextual regime constraints become integrated into a control envelope that determines whether inflammatory activation can safely exit back toward physiological stability. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because the principal ontological unit is the system-level capacity for active inflammatory termination and recovery rather than a single resolution episode or a single molecular pathway. This arising establishes the multicellular pro-resolving control condition through which inflammation can remain bounded in duration and magnitude instead of transitioning into chronic pathological regimes.

arisings.Name: Inflammation–Metabolic Dysregulation Feedback Loop
arisings.ShortDescription: Pattern-level self-reinforcing organism-scale loop in which chronic inflammation and metabolic dysregulation mutually stabilize one another.
arisings.Description: Inflammation–Metabolic Dysregulation Feedback Loop denotes the admissible pattern-level arising through which persistent inflammatory signaling and metabolic dysregulation become reciprocally coupled into a self-reinforcing organism-scale regime. This arising is not merely the coexistence of inflammation and altered metabolism, but a structured feedback pattern in which inflammatory mediators impair insulin sensitivity, nutrient handling, mitochondrial efficiency, and tissue metabolic coordination, while metabolic dysfunction in turn amplifies immune activation, stress signaling, lipid toxicity, altered adipokine release, and further inflammatory persistence. The mutual reinforcement of these processes creates a durable loop in which each side stabilizes the other and pushes the organism away from prior homeostatic balance. This pattern can propagate through adipose remodeling, altered substrate partitioning, chronic cytokine exposure, gut-derived inflammatory input, and impaired resolution, thereby integrating immune and metabolic disturbance into a unified chronic operating structure. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a pattern because it expresses a reproducible higher-order organization of reciprocal constraint and reinforcement rather than a single object or one-directional causal episode.

arisings.Name: Adipose Immune Remodeling and Inflammatory Adipokine Bias
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level adipose immune-metabolic reconfiguration in which immune remodeling, matrix change, and adipokine bias stabilize chronic inflammatory signaling.
arisings.Description: Adipose Immune Remodeling and Inflammatory Adipokine Bias denote the admissible process-level arising through which adipose tissue undergoes a persistent reorganization from a predominantly energy-buffering and endocrine-supportive state toward an immune-metabolic signaling regime marked by inflammatory bias. This arising is not reducible to increased fat mass alone. It consists in an ongoing tissue-scale remodeling process involving shifts in adipose-resident immune populations, altered macrophage behavior, extracellular matrix restructuring, adipocyte stress, changed vascular and stromal relations, and progressive reweighting of adipokine secretion toward inflammatory coordination. As this process advances, adipose tissue becomes a durable contributor to chronic cytokine exposure, altered immune recruitment, metabolic dysregulation, and organism-wide inflammatory reinforcement. The arising therefore captures the transition by which adipose organization becomes an active participant in chronic inflammatory maintenance rather than a passive storage compartment. Within SOMA this is a process because its identity lies in the continuing trajectory of tissue remodeling and immune-metabolic reconfiguration.

arisings.Name: Metabolic Endotoxemia as a Gut-Derived Driver of Basal Immune Activation
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level chronic gut-derived initiation regime in which dysbiosis and microbial-component translocation repeatedly elevate basal immune activation and stabilize inflammatory baseline shift.
arisings.Description: Metabolic Endotoxemia as a Gut-Derived Driver of Basal Immune Activation denotes the admissible process-level arising through which recurrent gut-derived immunogenic flux, conditioned by dysbiosis and barrier dysfunction, repeatedly initiates low-intensity innate immune stimulation and progressively stabilizes an elevated inflammatory baseline. This arising is not a single endotoxin pulse and not merely a passive consequence of permeability increase. It is a chronic initiation process in which microbial-component translocation repeatedly crosses inflammatory thresholds, engages innate sensing systems, and contributes to the persistent maintenance of organism-wide immune activation above prior homeostatic background. Over time, repeated low-level triggering interacts with tissue inflammatory microenvironments, cytokine baselines, metabolic dysregulation, and trained innate responsiveness, causing the initiating impulses to become integrated into a durable inflammatory operating regime. The arising therefore formalizes how gut-derived immune challenge can function as a continuing low-grade ignition mechanism for chronic inflammatory persistence rather than as an isolated acute insult.

arisings.Name: Systemic Allocation Trade-off between Immune Surveillance and Repair
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level organism-scale allocation constraint balancing surveillance-oriented immune functions against repair- and resolution-oriented priorities under chronic load.
arisings.Description: Systemic Allocation Trade-off between Immune Surveillance and Repair denotes the admissible property-level arising through which organism-level immune regulation settles into a constrained balance between surveillance-oriented functions and repair-oriented functions under chronic inflammatory, infectious, degenerative, or aging-related load. This arising is not a simple alternation between two tasks. It is a persistent allocation property of the organism expressed in how immune resources, signaling priorities, activation thresholds, effector deployment, and regulatory attention are distributed between elimination of infected, transformed, damaged, or senescent targets and support of tissue repair, resolution, regeneration, and structural maintenance. As chronic inflammatory background rises, these objectives increasingly compete for limited immune-operational capacity, so that gains in one dimension can narrow the admissible range of performance in the other. The arising thus captures a stable organism-level trade-off envelope governing how immune coordination apportions protective aggression versus reparative compatibility across tissues and time.

arisings.Name: Inflammaging Regime Stability and Hysteresis
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level self-maintaining chronic inflammatory regime that resists reversal through hysteresis and feedback-dominated persistence.
arisings.Description: Inflammaging Regime Stability and Hysteresis denote the admissible property-level arising through which chronic low-grade inflammation becomes stabilized as a self-maintaining organism-level regime that resists reversal even after partial weakening of its initiating drivers. This arising is not identical to chronic low-grade inflammation itself, but to a higher-order stability property of that regime once repeated inflammatory activation, impaired resolution, immune-metabolic feedback loops, tissue inflammatory microenvironments, senescence-associated signaling, and altered repair balance have become sufficiently integrated to create path dependence. In such a configuration, the threshold for entering the inflammatory regime becomes lower than the threshold for fully exiting it, producing hysteresis: the organism remains trapped in an elevated inflammatory state despite only modest current stimulation. The arising therefore captures the fact that chronic inflammatory persistence is not always maintained by strong ongoing triggers alone, but can become structurally stabilized by feedback-dominated regime memory. Within SOMA this is a property because it characterizes the long-term stability structure of an organismal inflammatory regime rather than constituting a separate bounded process or tissue object.

arisings.Name: Age-Associated Immune Remodeling (Immunosenescence)
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level organism-scale remodeling of immune composition, responsiveness and regulatory balance with age and chronic inflammatory load, followed along longitudinal immune-age trajectories.
arisings.Description: Age-Associated Immune Remodeling (Immunosenescence) denotes the admissible property-level arising through which the composition, responsiveness and regulatory balance of the organism's immune system change progressively with age under the combined influence of adaptive-compartment remodeling, trained innate reprogramming and persistent low-grade inflammatory background. This arising is not identical to chronic inflammation itself and not reducible to one isolated defect in either innate or adaptive immunity. It is expressed through loss of naive lymphocyte reserves, shifted frequencies of memory and innate cell subsets, biased innate reactivity and narrowed adaptive flexibility, which individuals traverse along heterogeneous longitudinal trajectories that can be summarized as an immune age associated with clinical outcome. Within SOMA this is classified as a property because it characterizes the organism by its age-dependent immune state rather than by one bounded process episode or one discrete immune object.

arisings.Name: Vasomotor Regulation of Tissue Perfusion
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level arising of demand-coupled control of local blood flow through mural-cell-mediated changes of vessel diameter.
arisings.Description: Vasomotor Regulation of Tissue Perfusion denotes the admissible process-level arising through which a formed vascular network matches local blood flow to tissue demand by changing vessel diameter. Within Level 5 this arising is expressed as dynamic control of arteriolar, precapillary and capillary tone by contractile mural cells, whose state is set by local metabolic, endothelial and neural signals, so that activity in a tissue is followed within seconds by a matched change in local perfusion. The arising is realized through smooth-muscle contractility and relaxation, vasoactive signaling such as nitric oxide and prostaglandin pathways, and coupling to neural activity; arteriolar smooth-muscle segments produce prompt dilation and constriction, while the contribution of capillary pericytes depends on preparation and remains unresolved. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because the principal ontological unit is the ongoing regulation of flow rather than the vascular network that carries it. This arising establishes the demand-coupled perfusion control required for organ homeostasis and for the coupling of blood supply to neural activity.

arisings.Name: Formation of Neural Networks
arisings.ShortDescription: Stable pattern-level formation of reproducible neural connectivity architectures enabling distributed signal propagation, coordination, and later specialization.
arisings.Description: Formation of Neural Networks denotes the admissible pattern-level establishment of persistent connectivity architectures among differentiated excitable cells, yielding reproducible topologies, directed pathways, weighted couplings, and modular organization. Within Level 6 this arising is not a transient growth episode and not a single bounded object, but a stable relational pattern in which neurons become organized into enduring connection graphs that constrain future propagation dynamics. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a pattern because its identity is defined primarily by repeatable structural organization across many cellular carriers rather than by one individuated material body. The resulting network architecture provides the structural substrate for coordinated signal transmission, long-range integration, local clustering, hub formation, rhythmic coupling, plastic reweighting, and later functional specialization without yet implying learning, cognition, or behavior as distinct higher-order arisings.

arisings.Name: Synaptic Plasticity and Learning
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level activity-dependent reconfiguration of synaptic connectivity that stores prior activation into future neural response dynamics.
arisings.Description: Synaptic Plasticity and Learning denotes the admissible process-level reconfiguration of synaptic strengths, efficacies, and local connectivity patterns within established neural networks as a function of activity history. Within Level 6 this arising consists in temporally extended modification dynamics including potentiation, depression, synaptic stabilization, and weakening, through which prior activation leaves persistent causal traces in later network behavior. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because its identity depends on ordered change over time rather than on a static object, pattern, or property taken in isolation. Learning at this level is therefore treated as regulated trajectory-level updating of neural connection architecture through activity-sensitive synaptic mechanisms, without yet requiring symbolic representation, explicit world models, cognition, or conscious awareness. This arising establishes the dynamic basis for adaptive retention, experience-sensitive reweighting, and selective reshaping of neural propagation pathways within already formed network organization.

arisings.Name: Brain Oscillations and Rhythms
arisings.ShortDescription: Pattern-level coherent temporal organization of distributed neural activity expressed through recurrent frequencies, phase relations, and cross-network rhythmic coupling.
arisings.Description: Brain Oscillations and Rhythms denotes the admissible pattern-level formation of coherent temporal organization across distributed neural populations, expressed through recurring frequency bands, phase relations, synchrony structures, and cross-frequency coupling regimes. Within Level 6 this arising is not a single event of firing and not an individuated object, but a reproducible dynamical pattern distributed across many interacting neural carriers and recurrent pathways. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a pattern because its identity is determined by stable relational organization in time across neural ensembles rather than by one bounded material unit or by a single transition episode. These oscillatory regimes establish temporal windows for coordination, gating, routing, entrainment, and phase-sensitive interaction within and between neural networks. They function as network-level timing architectures that constrain when interactions become effective and how activity propagates, without yet implying semantic content, symbolic representation, cognition, or conscious experience as distinct higher-order arisings.

arisings.Name: Cognitive Processing and Decision Making
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level integration, evaluation, and selection among alternative neural states producing controlled commitment to internal or action-guiding outcomes.
arisings.Description: Cognitive Processing and Decision Making denotes the admissible process-level organization by which neural systems integrate distributed activity over time, evaluate competing alternatives, and commit to selected internal states or action-guiding outcomes through coordinated population dynamics. Within Level 6 this arising consists in temporally extended operations such as evidence accumulation, state competition, inhibitory selection, threshold crossing, and commitment formation across interacting neural assemblies. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because its identity is defined by ordered transitions and regulated selection dynamics unfolding through time rather than by a static pattern, bounded object, or abstract property considered alone. Cognition at this level therefore refers to structured neural control and admissible state selection implemented within network dynamics, without yet requiring symbolic language, explicit social norm systems, or reflective self-awareness. This arising establishes the process architecture by which neural systems transform distributed signals into constrained selections that guide behavior, internal regulation, and context-sensitive control.

arisings.Name: Sensory Integration and Perception
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level integration, alignment, and stabilization of multisensory neural inputs into coherent perceptual states under noise and partial information.
arisings.Description: Sensory Integration and Perception denotes the admissible process-level organization by which neural systems combine signals from multiple sensory modalities into unified, spatially and temporally coherent perceptual states. Within Level 6 this arising consists in temporally extended operations of convergence, alignment, weighting, disambiguation, contextual modulation, and stability maintenance across distributed neural pathways receiving heterogeneous sensory inputs. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because its identity is defined by ordered integrative transformations unfolding through time rather than by a static object, isolated pattern, or abstract property. Perception at this level therefore refers to the regulated neural construction of integrated sensory states that remain sufficiently coherent under noise, incompleteness, and cross-modal variation, without yet presupposing conscious awareness, semantic interpretation, or symbolic categorization. This arising establishes the process architecture through which sensory systems transform parallel modality-specific inputs into coordinated perceptual outcomes that can guide later cognition and action.

arisings.Name: Motor Coordination and Control
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level neural regulation of movement through sequencing, timing, prediction, and feedback-based stabilization of motor execution.
arisings.Description: Motor Coordination and Control denotes the admissible process-level organization by which neural systems integrate sensory input, internal state, and motor command dynamics to generate coherent, adaptive movement patterns. Within Level 6 this arising consists in temporally extended operations of sequencing, initiation, timing regulation, predictive adjustment, feedback correction, gain control, and distributed stabilization across sensorimotor circuits. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because its identity is defined by ordered control dynamics unfolding through time rather than by a static network pattern, bounded object, or isolated property. Motor control at this level therefore refers to the structured neural regulation of movement execution and online correction within distributed circuits, without yet requiring explicit intentionality, goal semantics, or social-context interpretation. This arising establishes the process architecture through which neural systems transform integrated signals into coordinated motor outputs that remain stable, adaptable, and error-sensitive under changing conditions.

arisings.Name: Emotional and Affective Processing
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level global evaluative state organization in neural systems that biases cognition, perception, learning, and action through distributed modulation.
arisings.Description: Emotional and Affective Processing denotes the admissible property-level emergence of global evaluative state organization within neural systems, expressed through distributed valence, arousal, salience, and motivational biasing conditions that modulate ongoing processing across multiple circuits. Within Level 6 this arising is not a single bounded object and not merely a transient sequence of events, but a system-wide property of neural organization in which large-scale processing becomes selectively biased toward particular priorities, thresholds, and response tendencies. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because its identity lies in a regime-like evaluative condition attributable to the organized neural system rather than in one isolated process or pattern alone. Affect at this level functions as a dynamic evaluative property that reallocates processing resources, shifts learning sensitivity, alters decision thresholds, modulates perceptual weighting, and changes motor readiness across distributed networks, without yet requiring symbolic interpretation, language, or socially constructed meaning. This arising establishes the evaluative bias architecture through which neural systems become differentially tuned to relevance, urgency, and adaptive priority.

arisings.Name: Global Neurotransmitter Modulation
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level system-wide neuromodulatory state organization that shifts excitability, gain, learning sensitivity, and operating regimes across large-scale neural networks.
arisings.Description: Global Neurotransmitter Modulation denotes the admissible property-level organization by which diffuse neuromodulatory transmitter systems impose system-wide chemical biasing conditions across large-scale neural networks. Within Level 6 this arising is expressed through broad modulation of excitability, gain, responsiveness, learning sensitivity, threshold setting, and regime selection by transmitters such as dopamine, serotonin, noradrenaline, and acetylcholine acting over extended spatial and temporal scales. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because its identity lies in a global regulatory condition attributable to the organized neural system rather than in one isolated event, bounded object, or static connectivity pattern. This arising configures whole-system operating modes that bias how existing networks process signals, respond to perturbation, and transition between functional regimes without requiring alteration of core network topology. It establishes a chemically mediated global control property through which neural systems become tunably reconfigurable across attention, arousal, reinforcement sensitivity, and state-dependent responsiveness.

arisings.Name: Neuronal Avalanches and Near-Critical Network Dynamics
arisings.ShortDescription: Pattern-level scale-spanning cascade organization of collective neural activity (neuronal avalanches) and the near-critical operating regime it may indicate.
arisings.Description: Neuronal Avalanches and Near-Critical Network Dynamics denotes the admissible pattern-level organization in which collective neural activity propagates in cascades whose sizes and durations follow scale-spanning distributions, a regime shifted by changes of the excitation–inhibition balance and proposed to reflect operation near a critical transition. Within Level 6 this arising is not a single event and not a property of one neuron, but a reproducible relational pattern of collective dynamics across many neural carriers. Avalanche statistics alone do not establish criticality, which remains a hypothesis, and rhythmic phase synchronization is a distinct oscillatory pattern. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a pattern because its identity lies in the statistical organization of activity propagation rather than in one bounded object or process episode.

arisings.Name: Emergence of Conscious Experience
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level organized experiential presence arising when neural organization sustains sufficiently integrated and temporally coherent conscious access.
arisings.Description: Emergence of Conscious Experience denotes the hypothesized admissible property-level arising through which distributed neural organization sustains an organized form of conscious access and experiential presence under conditions of sufficient large-scale integration, temporal coherence, recurrent availability, and cross-domain coordination. This arising is not identified with any single oscillation band, local circuit, anatomical structure, or one universally accepted mechanism. Instead, it refers to a regime-level property attributable to the organized neural system when neural dynamics become capable of enabling reportable, integrated, and temporally sustained experience as such. The node is therefore intentionally formulated at the level of admissibility rather than at the level of final explanatory closure. Within SOMA this is a property because its identity lies in a system-level condition of the organized neural whole, not in one bounded object, one isolated process episode, or one fixed connectivity pattern.

arisings.Name: Regulation of Sleep–Wake Cycles
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level global state regulation of neural operating modes governing transitions between wakefulness and sleep.
arisings.Description: Regulation of Sleep–Wake Cycles denotes the admissible property-level organization by which neural systems maintain and transition between distinct global operating modes corresponding to wakefulness and sleep. Within Level 6 this arising is expressed as a system-wide regulatory condition involving coordinated changes in excitability, synchrony structure, neuromodulatory tone, oscillatory organization, and large-scale patterns of information flow. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because its identity lies in a global regime-defining condition attributable to the organized neural system rather than in one isolated event, static pattern, or bounded object. This arising governs access to wakeful responsiveness, sleep-stage organization, plastic consolidation windows, metabolic recovery allocation, and homeostatic restoration timing across the neural system. It functions as a network-wide control property that gates the admissibility of consciousness-related availability, modulates learning efficiency, and stabilizes organism-level coordination, without itself constituting conscious content or specific cognitive processing.

arisings.Name: Functional Specialization of Neural Ensembles
arisings.ShortDescription: Pattern-level stabilization of distinct functional roles in mesoscopic neural subsets within large-scale network organization.
arisings.Description: Functional Specialization of Neural Ensembles denotes the admissible pattern-level organization in which subsets of neurons within large-scale neural networks acquire stable and preferential roles in processing, integration, coordination, or control. Within Level 6 this arising is not a single bounded object and not merely a transient activation episode, but a reproducible mesoscopic pattern defined by differentiated recurrent participation, intra-ensemble coherence, inter-ensemble coordination, and role-specific deployment across broader network architecture. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a pattern because its identity is determined by stable relational organization among groups of neural carriers rather than by one isolated process or one intrinsic property of individual neurons. These ensembles function as intermediate organizational units bridging single-neuron activity and whole-network dynamics, enabling modular differentiation, repeated functional allocation, and structured division of labor while preserving global coherence. This arising establishes the patterned mesoscopic organization through which neural systems become functionally differentiated without yet requiring symbolic representation or conscious awareness.

arisings.Name: Information Processing in Neural Connectomes
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level distributed transformation, routing, and integration of activity across large-scale neural connectivity architectures.
arisings.Description: Information Processing in Neural Connectomes denotes the admissible process-level organization by which the structural topology and dynamical regimes of large-scale neural connectivity architectures jointly enable distributed transformation, routing, propagation, and integration of activity. Within Level 6 this arising consists in temporally extended operations of parallel transmission, convergence, divergence, recurrent circulation, hub-mediated redistribution, and multi-path integration across the connectome. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because its identity is defined by ordered causal transformation and routing dynamics unfolding through time rather than by one static network pattern, bounded object, or abstract property. Information processing at this level refers to physically realized causal organization of population activity across connectomic structure, grounded in material connectivity and regime-dependent dynamics rather than abstract computation or symbolic manipulation. This arising establishes the process architecture through which large-scale neural systems propagate and transform activity across distributed pathways while preserving structured coordination across specialized and recurrently coupled subsystems.

arisings.Name: Astrocytic Regulation of Neural Activity
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level astrocytic control of the synaptic and network environment, through potassium and glutamate clearance, gliotransmission, lactate supply and neuromodulator-gated suppression of behavior, that tunes plasticity and behavioral state.
arisings.Description: Astrocytic Regulation of Neural Activity denotes the admissible property-level organization by which astrocytes maintain and modulate the operating conditions of neural circuits. It is realized through Kir4.1-dependent potassium buffering and transporter-mediated glutamate clearance, vesicular glutamate release by specialized astrocytes, lactate export through monocarboxylate transporters needed for long-term memory formation, and noradrenaline-driven astrocytic calcium integration that suppresses futile behavior. These conditions shape short- and long-term plasticity and behavioral state without encoding the content processed by neurons; astrocytic calcium elevation is not required for every form of hippocampal plasticity. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a property because its identity lies in a persistent regulatory condition of neural–astrocytic organization rather than in one event or object.

arisings.Name: Neural-State-Dependent Epigenetic and Transcriptional Modulation
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level cross-level regulation in which sustained neural states drive durable epigenetic and transcriptional reconfiguration in target cells.
arisings.Description: Neural-State-Dependent Epigenetic and Transcriptional Modulation denotes the admissible process-level arising through which sustained patterns of neural activity, neuromodulatory state, and neuroendocrine regulation induce durable changes in chromatin accessibility, transcriptional regulation, and epigenetic marking within target cells and tissues. This arising is not a simple one-step signaling event. It consists in an extended cross-level regulatory transformation linking neural-state organization to downstream molecular reconfiguration through activity-dependent transcriptional cascades, hormone-sensitive pathways, intracellular signaling networks, and long-duration gene-regulatory adjustment. As this process unfolds, target cells can shift responsiveness, stress adaptation, differentiation bias, metabolic readiness, or long-term functional profile in ways aligned with organism-level neural context. The arising therefore captures a genuine downward causal process in SOMA terms, in which higher-order neural-state regimes reshape lower-level molecular permissibility without erasing the molecular substrate on which that reshaping is realized.

arisings.Name: Neuro–Immune Interactions
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level bidirectional cross-system coupling through which neural states and immune activity reciprocally modulate one another.
arisings.Description: Neuro–Immune Interactions denotes the admissible process-level reciprocal coupling by which neural network dynamics and immune signaling mutually modulate inflammation, immune readiness, neural excitability, plasticity, and network stability. Within Level 6 this arising consists in temporally extended cross-system exchange mediated through autonomic pathways, neuroendocrine signaling, neuromodulators, cytokines, inflammatory mediators, and tissue-level immune feedback. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because its identity is defined by ongoing bidirectional modulation and causal exchange across organizational systems rather than by one static property, bounded object, or stable pattern alone. This arising formalizes a diagonal causal loop linking neural dynamics with organismal defense and maintenance mechanisms, allowing neural activity to reshape immune responses while immune state feeds back to alter gain, stability, affective bias, and plastic adaptability of neural organization. It establishes a cross-level regulatory process through which organism-wide physiological defense and neural coordination become reciprocally coupled.

arisings.Name: Neurovascular Coupling
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level coupling of local cerebral blood flow to neural activity, in which activity-associated signals are sensed by the vascular wall and conducted to upstream arterioles to raise local perfusion.
arisings.Description: Neurovascular Coupling denotes the admissible process-level arising through which local neural activity is translated into matched changes of blood supply within the neurovascular unit. Activity-associated signals, among them extracellular potassium sensed by capillary endothelial inward-rectifier (Kir2.1) channels whose availability depends on membrane PIP2, initiate endothelial hyperpolarization that is conducted upstream through gap-junction-coupled endothelium to dilate feeding arterioles and increase red-cell flux; mural cells, astrocytes and neuromodulators contribute further routes whose relative roles remain open. The arising couples two organizational systems, neural activity as the initiating signal and the vascular network as substrate and effector, and is not a property of either alone. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because its identity lies in ordered sensing, conduction and vasomotor response through time rather than in a vessel object or a static perfusion pattern.

arisings.Name: Restricted Adult Neurogenesis
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level generation, maturation and functional integration of new neurons from adult neural stem cells in restricted niches, at rates that differ strongly between species and decline with age.
arisings.Description: Restricted Adult Neurogenesis denotes the admissible process-level arising through which adult neural stem cells in restricted niches, principally the dentate subgranular zone and the subventricular zone with its migratory route to the olfactory bulb, leave quiescence, proliferate, commit to neuronal fate, migrate, mature and integrate as functional circuit members. Niche signals and local circuit activity, such as parvalbumin-interneuron GABA acting on radial glia-like stem cells, regulate quiescence and fate; experience such as learning and running modulates proliferation and survival; integrated adult-born neurons receive input, form output synapses and can change network-level discrimination. The process is restricted: it is absent from most of the adult brain, declines with age, and its extent in adult humans remains contested. It adds new neurons and does not concern the rewiring of existing ones. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because its identity lies in an ordered developmental trajectory of new cells through time.

arisings.Name: Working Memory and Executive Functions
arisings.ShortDescription: Process-level temporary maintenance, manipulation, and top-down control of neural activity enabling short-window retention and flexible regulation.
arisings.Description: Working Memory and Executive Functions denotes the admissible process-level organization by which neural systems temporarily sustain, manipulate, update, and control activity patterns over short temporal windows while exerting top-down regulation over processing and action selection. Within Level 6 this arising consists in temporally extended operations of transient maintenance, gating, inhibition, monitoring, switching, selective biasing, and controlled updating across distributed neural circuits. Within SOMA this arising is classified as a process because its identity is defined by ordered control dynamics unfolding through time rather than by one bounded object, static pattern, or regime property alone. Working memory at this level is treated as an operational control process of neural dynamics rather than as long-term storage, narrative identity, or symbolic reasoning. This arising establishes the short-horizon control architecture through which neural systems maintain task-relevant states, regulate interference, coordinate flexible resource allocation, and support context-sensitive selection under changing demands.

arisings.Name: Neural Mechanisms of Symbolic Representation
arisings.ShortDescription: Property-level neural capacity to sustain and manipulate abstract internal representations detached from immediate sensory instantiation.
arisings.Description: Neural Mechanisms of Symbolic Representation denote the hypothesized admissible property-level arising through which neural organization acquires the capacity to form, stabilize, manipulate, and recombine internal representational states that functionally stand in for classes of objects, relations, actions, rules, or hypothetical configurations beyond immediate sensory instantiation. This arising is not identical to simple sensory coding, stimulus-response association, or transient activation of perceptual traces. It refers to a higher-order representational capacity in which internally maintained neural states can preserve abstract reference, support combinatorial transformation, participate in rule-sensitive manipulation, and remain operative across delays, context shifts, and non-present targets. The property depends on coordinated cognitive control, working-memory maintenance, ensemble specialization, and recurrent representational stabilization, through which neural systems can detach operative structure from immediate perceptual input and use it in planning, inference, communication, and structured reasoning. Within SOMA this is a property because it characterizes an organized neural system by a stable representational capacity rather than by one isolated process episode, bounded object, or single pattern instance.

arisings.Name: Neural Mechanisms of Social Recognition and Empathy
